how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_010.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|entityculling|text.entityculling.ta: Block entities selected in this tab will not be culled at all. This is mainly needed for block entities that need to be rendered regardless of their visibility.
items.lang|entityculling|text.entityculling.re: When turned off, culled entities will not have their nametags rendered through walls.
items.lang|entityculling|text.entityculling.ti: When turned on, entities that are culled will not tick. This can improve performance in some cases, but may cause issues with certain mods. Consider the finer control options in the other tab.
items.lang|entityculling|text.entityculling.di: When turned on, the F3 debug info will not show culling information.
items.lang|entityculling|text.entityculling.sk: When turned on, culling of entities will be skipped entirely. This can be useful for debugging or when you want to disable culling temporarily.
When turned on, culling of block entities will be skipped entirely. This can be useful for debugging or when you want to disable culling temporarily.
items.lang|entityculling|text.entityculling.bl: When turned on, block entity state extraction will be culled based on the camera's view frustum. This can improve performance in case your modloader/another mod doesn't do this already.
items.lang|entityculling|text.entityculling.fo: When turned on, display entities without a bounding box will get assigned a default bounding box for culling purposes. This can improve performance for maps/servers that do not configure their display entities correctly, but can cause visual issues.
items.lang|entityculling|text.entityculling.so: When turned on, leaves will be treated as solid for culling purposes. This can improve performance in forests, but also cause visual issues. Useful when setting 'See-Through Leaves' to Off, or using a bushy leaves resource pack.
items.lang|trender|text.trender.style.tooltip: Changes the UI Style for all of mods by tr7zw.
items.lang|trender|text.trender.sendstacktrace: When enabled, stacktraces in the log or game crashes that contain mod references to mods by tr7zw will be sent to the mod author via Sentry (Sentry.io) to help fix bugs faster. No personal information is collected or sent. (Restart the game after turning it on)

Greetings, adventurer! How may I assist you?
Having bested either myself or the Ender Dragon, your strength is unquestionable. If you'd like to face me again, I am ready for the challenge.
I respect your bravery! However, this challenge is not to be taken lightly. Are you... truly prepared to face me now?
To trade with me, you must first prove your worth in battle.
I have guarded this place for ages, and perhaps I deserve a break. However, if I leave, you will no longer be able to challenge me or trade with me. Are you... sure this is what you wish?
